主要内容: On April 5, 2013, DISH DBS Corporation, an indirect wholly-owned subsidiary of DISH Network Corporation, issued $1.1 billion in 5.125% Senior Notes due 2020 and $1.2 billion in 4.250% Senior Notes due 2018 at issue prices of 100%. The notes were issued under indentures described in Item 2.03, with the 2020 Notes maturing on May 1, 2020, and the 2018 Notes maturing on April 1, 2018. The indentures include covenants limiting the Company’s ability to incur debt, pay dividends, and engage in certain transactions. DISH Network may redeem Notes at any time with 30-60 days notice, with redemption prices including principal, accrued interest, and a make-whole premium. Events of default include nonpayment, covenant breaches, and bankruptcy, which may trigger immediate payment of all Notes.
